en.hero_eyebrow: Freelance SEA Specialist for Google Ads Campaigns
en.svc_meta_desc: Freelance Google Ads services: campaign management, scripts & automation, and strategy audits. Direct access to a senior specialist, no agency overhead.
en.svc_h1:
Three things I do.
All of them well.
en.svc_sub: I don't offer twelve services to look impressive. I offer three, and I've spent 8 years getting very good at each of them. Here's exactly what you get when we work together.
en.svc_stat1_desc: Services. Not twelve. Each one done by me, end to end.
en.svc1_p1: This is the core of what I do. I build, structure, and actively manage Google Ads campaigns across Search, Shopping, Display, and Demand Gen, with one goal: making your budget work harder than it currently does.
en.svc1_p2: I don't hand your account to a junior after the onboarding call. I'm in it every week, adjusting bids, refining match types, killing underperformers, testing new angles. You'll know exactly what I'm doing and why, because I send you reports in plain language, not dashboards full of numbers that don't tell you anything.
en.svc1_for: For: accounts that aren't performing, or launching from scratch
en.svc1_d2: Keyword strategy and match type architecture
en.svc1_d3: Ad copy writing and A/B testing
en.svc2_p1: There's a ceiling on what manual Google Ads management can achieve. Scripts break through it.
en.svc2_p2: I write custom Google Ads scripts that automate the repetitive, error-prone work that eats hours every week: flagging wasted spend, pacing budgets, monitoring performance anomalies, generating reports. Work that takes a human three hours takes a script three seconds.
en.svc2_p3: My free tool, Capybara NegativeIQ Search, is a good example of what this looks like in practice: it connects your Google Ads account to AI, classifies every search term automatically, protects converting keywords, and tells you exactly what to add as a negative. That's the kind of edge a well-written script gives you.
en.svc2_for: For: managers and teams who want to work smarter, not longer
en.svc2_d5: Custom scripts for your specific needs
en.svc3_p1: Sometimes you don't need someone to run your ads. You need someone to tell you honestly what's wrong with them and what to do about it.
en.svc3_p2: I audit Google Ads accounts from top to bottom: campaign structure, keyword strategy, match types, bidding logic, ad copy, landing page alignment, and conversion tracking. No diplomatic softening. You'll get a clear picture of what's working, what's wasting money, and a prioritized list of exactly what to fix.
en.svc3_p3: If you're running ads in-house and want an expert second opinion, this is where we start. If you want me to take over the account after the audit, that's on the table too, but there's no pressure to go further than the audit itself.
en.svc3_for: For: in-house teams wanting clarity, new clients testing the waters
en.svc3_d1: A thorough look at your whole account, not just the obvious stuff
en.svc3_d2: A written summary of everything I found, in plain language
en.svc3_d3: A clear list of what to fix, in what order, and why
en.svc3_d4: A follow-up call to go through it together and figure out next steps
en.focus_title: I work across verticals, with a few areas I know particularly well.
en.focus_1_desc: If your business lives and dies by qualified leads (forms, calls, demos), I know how to build campaigns that attract the right ones and filter out the noise. Tight keyword architecture, strong negative lists, and tracking that goes beyond the click.
en.focus_2_desc: For online stores it's all about ROAS. I manage Shopping campaigns, optimize product feeds, and build remarketing structures that recover lost revenue without inflating spend.
en.focus_3_desc: Not everything needs to convert today. I build upper-funnel campaigns (Display, Demand Gen, YouTube) that keep you visible to the right audiences while your bottom-funnel campaigns close the deal.
en.contact_title: Not sure where to start? Start here.
en.contact_sub: Send me a message and I'll take a free look at your Google Ads account. No pitch, no commitment, just an honest assessment of where you stand and what I'd do differently.

en.script_page_title: AI Max NegativeIQ — Free Google Ads Tool
en.script_tagline: Stop guessing which search terms are wasting your budget. Let AI tell you.
en.script_sub: A free, open-source tool that connects your Google Ads account to AI, classifies every search term, protects what's converting, and tells you exactly what to add as a negative. Built for Search campaigns. V2 is in development.
en.script_cta_github: View on GitHub
en.what_title: Your search terms, intelligently classified by AI.
en.what_p1: Most Google Ads accounts are leaking budget on search terms that will never convert — job seekers, competitors, irrelevant queries. Manually reviewing them is slow, error-prone, and doesn't scale. AI Max NegativeIQ automates the entire process.
en.what_p2: Every day, the Fetcher pulls your latest search terms into a Google Sheet. The Analyzer sends them to an AI — which classifies each one based on your industry, your business, and your conversion data. Not generic rules. Actual context.
en.what_p3: Every term gets a classification, a confidence score, and a one-line explanation. You review, correct if needed, and push negatives back into your account in one click.
en.conv_protect_desc: Any term that has driven a conversion is automatically protected — never flagged.
en.mockup_note: Example output. Your real data, your real account.
en.comp_1_desc: Runs daily. Pulls every search term from your Search campaigns, deduplicates them, and aggregates clicks and conversions over a 30-day window. Writes everything to your Google Sheet automatically.
en.comp_2_desc: The intelligence layer. Sends search terms to AI in scalable batches. Each term returns with a classification, a 0–1 confidence score, and a plain-language explanation. Config-driven: define your industry once.
en.comp_3_desc: Four tabs, all automated. SearchTerms is your working surface — color-coded by classification, confidence-scored, with a one-click export. Config is the only thing you touch per account. Negative_Export holds validated negatives ready to push. Expansion_Ideas captures search terms worth building new campaigns around.
en.install_sub: The Config and API key are a one-time effort. If you can paste text and click a button, you can run this.
en.step1_desc: Open the template from GitHub, make a copy, and fill in the Config tab — your industry, business name, and 5–8 example classifications.
en.step2_title: Add the Fetcher to Google Ads
en.step2_desc: Tools → Scripts → New. Paste the Fetcher code, replace the Sheet URL, authorize it, and set it to run daily.
en.step3_title: Add the Analyzer to your Sheet
en.step3_desc: Extensions → Apps Script. Paste the Analyzer code, save, and authorize. A new menu item appears in your Sheet.
en.step4_desc: Click AI Max NegativeIQ → Prepare Layout. Styles all four tabs, adds color coding, and sets up dropdowns.
en.step5_desc: Next day, classify all new terms, review the AI's suggestions, validate, and push negatives to your account in one click.
en.code_title: It's real code. Here's a slice.
en.github_sub: If it saves you money, a GitHub star goes a long way. It helps other Google Ads specialists find the tool.
en.github_cta: View on GitHub
en.bmc_desc: The tool is free and always will be. But if it saved you wasted spend, a coffee goes a long way — and makes the next script happen faster.
en.upsell_title: Want this running on your account today?
en.upsell_desc: I can set this up, customize the Config for your industry, and have it classifying your search terms by tomorrow. That's what I do.
en.pmax_title: Running Performance Max? v2 is on its way.
en.pmax_desc: The current version covers Search campaigns. A PMax variant is in development — drop me a message to be notified.
en.footer_copy: © 2024 Click-Capybara · The Google Ads specialist in your corner.
en.calc_title: How long will AI-Classify take on your account?
en.calc_sub: Google Apps Script has a 6-minute execution limit. Drag the sliders to see how your keyword count and batch size affect runtime — and whether you'll need more than one run.

de.script_page_title: AI Max NegativeIQ — Kostenloses Google Ads Tool
de.script_tagline: Schluss mit dem Rätselraten. Lass die KI dir sagen, welche Suchbegriffe dein Budget verbrennen.
de.script_sub: Ein kostenloses Open-Source-Tool, das deinen Google Ads Account mit KI verbindet, jeden Suchbegriff klassifiziert, schützt was konvertiert, und sagt dir genau, was als Negativ-Keyword rein muss. Gebaut für Search-Kampagnen. V2 ist in Entwicklung.
de.script_cta_github: Auf GitHub ansehen
de.what_p1: Die meisten Google Ads Accounts verlieren täglich Budget an Suchbegriffe, die nie konvertieren werden. Jobsucher, Mitbewerber, irrelevante Anfragen. Sie manuell zu prüfen skaliert nicht. AI Max NegativeIQ automatisiert den gesamten Prozess.
de.what_p2: Der Fetcher holt täglich deine aktuellen Suchbegriffe in ein Google Sheet. Der Analyzer schickt sie an eine KI, die jeden Begriff anhand deiner Branche, deines Unternehmens und deiner Conversion-Daten klassifiziert. Keine generischen Regeln. Echter Kontext.
de.what_p3: Jeder Begriff bekommt eine Klassifizierung, einen Confidence-Score und eine einzeilige KI-Begründung. Du prüfst, korrigierst bei Bedarf, und buchst Negative mit einem Klick zurück ins Konto.
de.conv_protect_desc: Jeder Suchbegriff, der konvertiert hat, wird automatisch geschützt — nie als Negativ markiert.
de.mockup_note: Beispiel-Output. Deine echten Daten, dein echter Account.
de.comp_1_desc: Läuft täglich automatisch. Holt alle Suchbegriffe aus deinen Search-Kampagnen, dedupliziert sie und aggregiert Klicks und Conversions über 30 Tage. Schreibt alles automatisch ins Sheet.
de.comp_2_desc: Die Intelligenzschicht. Schickt Suchbegriffe in skalierbaren Batches an KI. Jeder Begriff bekommt eine Klassifizierung, einen Confidence-Score und eine verständliche Begründung. Konfigurierbar: Branche einmal definieren.
de.comp_3_desc: Vier Reiter, vollautomatisch. SearchTerms ist deine Arbeitsfläche — farbkodiert, confidence-bewertet, Ein-Klick-Export. Config ist die einzige Anpassung pro Account. Negative_Export enthält validierte Negative. Expansion_Ideen sammelt Begriffe mit Kampagnenpotenzial.
de.install_sub: Config und API-Key sind einmalig — danach läuft alles automatisch. Coden musst du nicht können.
de.step1_desc: Template von GitHub öffnen, Kopie erstellen, Config-Tab befüllen — Branche, Unternehmensname und 5–8 Beispiel-Klassifizierungen.
de.step2_desc: Tools → Scripts → Neu. Fetcher-Code einfügen, Sheet-URL ersetzen, autorisieren, auf täglich stellen.
de.step3_desc: Erweiterungen → Apps Script. Analyzer-Code einfügen, speichern, autorisieren. Ein neuer Menüpunkt erscheint im Sheet.
de.step4_desc: AI Max NegativeIQ → Prepare Layout. Stylt alle Reiter, fügt Farbkodierung hinzu und richtet Dropdowns ein.
de.step5_desc: Am nächsten Tag klassifizieren, Ergebnisse prüfen, validieren, Negative mit einem Klick buchen.
de.code_title: Echter Code. Hier ist ein Ausschnitt.
de.github_sub: Wenn es dir Budget spart, freue ich mich über einen GitHub-Star. Er hilft anderen Spezialisten, das Tool zu finden.
de.bmc_desc: Das Tool ist kostenlos und bleibt es. Aber wenn es dir Spend gespart hat — ein Kaffee hilft, dass das nächste Script schneller fertig wird.
de.upsell_title: Du möchtest es direkt auf deinem Account einrichten lassen?
de.upsell_desc: Setup, Config, fertig — das Tool läuft innerhalb eines Tages auf deinem Account. Wer das lieber in guten Händen weiß, ist hier richtig.
de.pmax_title: Du nutzt Performance Max? V2 ist in Arbeit.
de.pmax_desc: Aktuelle Version deckt Search ab. Eine PMax-Variante ist in Entwicklung — schreib mir, ich gebe Bescheid wenn sie fertig ist.

de.calc_title: Wie lange braucht AI-Classify auf deinem Account?
de.calc_sub: Google Apps Script hat ein 6-Minuten-Limit. Schiebe die Regler, um zu sehen, wie Keyword-Anzahl und Batch-Größe die Laufzeit beeinflussen.
